query: What methods quantify teachers’ policy interpretation as a mediator between written policy alignment and classroom 21CS enactment?

response.query: What methods quantify teachers’ policy interpretation as a mediator between written policy alignment and classroom 21CS enactment?
response.answer: Surveys and interviews quantify teachers’ policy interpretation as a mediator between written policy alignment and classroom 21CS enactment. Direct observations and coding schemes are also used. Teacher reflections and self-reports provide insights into policy interpretation.

results.title: Middle School Student Handbook - - Liberty Central School District
results.content: * When a student is habitually (1 x weekly) absent, tardy, or leaves early from class or school without excuse, the student’s guidance counselor, nurse, teacher or case manager will notify the student’s parent(s) by phone and/or mail of the specific ATED, remind them of the attendance policy, and review ATED intervention procedures with them. * Where consistent with other school practices, teachers and staff shall request a pass from students in the hallways who are absent from a class period without excuse and refer the students to the Building Principal or their designee. If a pattern of ATEDs for an individual student is identified a designated staff person(s) will follow-up in accordance with Liberty Central School District’s policy. The district will notify parents/guardians and eligible students annually at the beginning of the school year and upon enrollment of their rights under this policy.
